title: Two men re-arrested on suspicion of assisting Iran intelligence after RAF Fairford incident
description: The head of UK Counter Terrorism Policing said they consider Iranian state involvement "highly likely".

title: Zelensky says US intelligence sharing 'works now' after talks with Trump envoy in Oslo
description: Ukraine had accused the US of withholding key intelligence - a claim rejected as "scandalous" by Washington.

description: The sixth report from Covid inquiry criticises the lack of PPE and the way patients were discharged from hospital.

title: Schools should recognise antisemitism as distinct form of harm, review says
description: The government is expected to accept all 27 recommendations made in the review by ex-Ofsted boss, Sir David Bell.

title: Woman says she 'couldn't speak or breathe' during alleged rape by Russell Brand

title: UK government to make Jackdaw gas field announcement
description: The long-awaited decision about the controversial North Sea field is expected on Wednesday morning.
